_comment: B3-TUNE-v2 Priority 4 -- frozen v2 configuration, written before any v2 held-out content was read. Hard rule (verbatim-equivalent to eval/results/B3/frozen-config.json): any change to model, representation, retrieval config, metrics, or promotion criteria made AFTER reading any v2 held-out result invalidates that held-out run as independent evidence for this configuration.

representation_semantics.chunking_policy: none (Stage 1 decision; truncation events recorded per-note, not chunked)
representation_semantics.pooling: mean pooling over token embeddings, using attention mask to exclude padding

retrieval.candidate_ordering: score descending, then note-id lexicographic ascending tie-break (B1's existing convention)
retrieval.filtering_privacy_semantics: unchanged from B1's existing search_impl (project/type/status/trust/time filters, Sensitive-note redaction before embedding)
retrieval.sensitive_note_behavior: embedding input is built from text_searchable only, never raw note body; verified by this session's privacy test in the Stage 1 dense-DEV harness

hard_rule: Any change to retrieval_config, representation semantics, model, metric formulas, or promotion criteria made AFTER reading any v2 held-out (B3-TUNE-v2 Priority 4) result invalidates that held-out run as independent evidence for this configuration. This mirrors eval/results/B3/frozen-config.json's own hard rule verbatim in spirit.
rejected_candidate: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 + B1 hybrid-RRF (failed the nDCG@10-vs-dense-standalone gate at calibration)
official_baseline_unchanged: B1 (eval/results/B3/frozen-config.json, commit 52d42ea) remains the official baseline until/unless this v2 configuration passes v2 held-out validation
